Dialog.Choose: Choose a configured consumable or enter a manual amount.
Dialog.NoItems: No configured consumables were found. Enter a manual amount.

Notifications.TimekeepingDetected: Food: Simple Timekeeping detected. World-time integration is active.

Enabled.Name: Enable satiety tracking
Enabled.Hint: Show the widget and process world-time changes.

Hydration.Name: Enable hydration
Hydration.Hint: Show and process the optional hydration resource.

HoursToEmpty.Name: Hours until completely hungry
HoursToEmpty.Hint: Game hours required for satiety to fall from 100% to 0%.

WaterHoursToEmpty.Name: Hours until completely dehydrated
WaterHoursToEmpty.Hint: Game hours required for hydration to fall from 100% to 0%.

WhisperGM.Name: Whisper warnings to GM
WhisperGM.Hint: Include active GMs among hunger-message recipients.

ShowPercent.Name: Show exact percentages
ShowPercent.Hint: Players see exact values instead of only descriptive states.

PlayerAdjust.Name: Allow player controls
PlayerAdjust.Hint: Owners may eat and adjust their own character. GMs always can.

Exhaustion.Name: Apply exhaustion at 0%
Exhaustion.Hint: Increase D&D 5e exhaustion when satiety crosses 0%. Disabled by default.
